$uid..write: auth != null && auth.uid === $uid && root.child('users/' + auth.uid).exists() && newData.exists() && (data.child('version').val() !== 2 || newData.child('version').val() === 2) && (!data.child('baseline').exists() || newData.child('baseline').exists())
$uid..validate: !newData.child('version').exists() || (newData.child('version').val() === 2 && newData.child('learned').isNumber() && newData.child('learned').val() >= 0 && newData.child('learned').val() <= 300 && newData.child('level').isNumber() && newData.child('level').val() >= 0 && newData.child('level').val() <= 5 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 1000)

baseline..validate: newData.hasChildren(['right','total','ts']) && newData.child('total').val() === 30 && newData.child('right').val() >= 0 && newData.child('right').val() <= 30 && (!data.exists() || (newData.child('right').val() === data.child('right').val() && newData.child('ts').val() === data.child('ts').val()))

$date..validate: newData.child('chars').isString() && newData.child('chars').val().length > 0 && newData.child('chars').val().length <= 20 && (newData.child('reward').val() === 5 || newData.child('reward').val() === 10 || newData.child('reward').val() === 15) && (!data.exists() || (newData.child('chars').val() === data.child('chars').val() && newData.child('from').val() === data.child('from').val() && newData.child('to').val() === data.child('to').val() && newData.child('stage').val() === data.child('stage').val() && newData.child('reward').val() === data.child('reward').val() && (data.child('done').val() !== true || newData.child('done').val() === true)))

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['score','level','learned','mastered','baseline','current','growth','assessedAt','hasRecheck']) && newData.child('score').val() === root.child('hanja/' + $uid + '/score').val() && newData.child('level').val() === root.child('hanja/' + $uid + '/level').val() && newData.child('learned').val() === root.child('hanja/' + $uid + '/learned').val() && newData.child('baseline').val() === root.child('hanja/' + $uid + '/baseline/right').val() && newData.child('mastered').val() >= 0 && newData.child('mastered').val() <= 300 && newData.child('growth').val() === newData.child('current').val() - newData.child('baseline').val()
